question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Something that cannot be handled easily
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unwieldy**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Unwieldy means not easily managed, handled, or used as because of bulk, weight, complexity, or awkwardness.

 
 
• Example - *We set about towing the **unwieldy **structure into the shelter.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that 'Unwieldy' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**Something that cannot be handled easily****​**'

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Untidy **means not tidy or well-arranged.
 
• **Untimely **means happening at a time or situation that is not suitable.
 
• **Unfit **means not suitable or not good enough for something.
